# Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups — facts

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-11-06 · 11 units · 2 sources · rights: quote -->

## Definitions

- [statement] A Kamino elevation group (eMode) is a curator-defined cluster of correlated assets (stablecoins, LSTs with their underlying SOL, wrapped assets with natives). A user joins voluntarily; the program then applies the group's LTV and liquidation threshold in place of per-reserve defaults. Leaving the group, or borrowing an asset outside it, restores the per-reserve defaults. (high confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/elevation-groups.md · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/glossary, https://kamino.com/docs/kamino-lend-litepaper
- [statement] A market supports at most 32 elevation groups (IDs 1-32; 0 means no group). Per the docs, a single reserve can opt into up to 20 groups, and group parameters only apply to reserves that list the group ID in their own elevation_groups array. (medium confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/elevation-groups.md · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/glossary
- [statement] Group configuration is not exposed through the REST API; a curator sets it through the SDK or Kamino CLI. Setting allow_new_loans to 0 pauses new borrows in a group while existing positions keep their relaxed parameters and can still repay and exit. (low confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/elevation-groups.md · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups
- [statement] Kamino's eMode is the elevation group. One lending market stores up to 32 groups (ids 1-32; id 0 means no group). Each group sets ltv_pct, liquidation_threshold_pct, max_liquidation_bonus_bps, allow_new_loans, max_reserves_as_collateral and exactly one debt_reserve. (high confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/elevation-groups.md · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://github.com/Kamino-Finance/klend/blob/77e81854909ab7ffea3a2e898b2554d96e07daac/programs/klend/src/state/lending_market.rs, https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/glossary

## How it works

- [statement] Kamino prices LSTs (JitoSOL, mSOL, bSOL) by stake rate (SOL_staked / LST_minted) read from the on-chain stake pool account, not by DEX price, so a temporary market depeg neither changes position health nor triggers liquidation. The same design exposes positions to genuine backing impairment such as a staking-protocol exploit, which lowers the stake rate. (high confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/security/oracles/lst-oracles · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/how-it-works, https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/risks
- [statement] The SDK's default Multiply open builder orders the transaction: refresh oracles; create or wrap token accounts; flash-borrow the collateral token from the collateral reserve; deposit; request the elevation group between deposit and borrow; refresh reserves and obligation; borrow the debt token; swap debt to collateral; flash-repay. A second builder flash-borrows the debt token first (swap, then deposit and borrow, then repay). Kamino's docs give a simplified seven-step order with the swap before the deposit. Because the default flash loan comes from the collateral reserve, it needs unborrowed collateral-token liquidity there. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/Kamino-Finance/klend-sdk/blob/6a26d6f1b5afb29953ffd139ee8c0c4ca5f26ce6/src/leverage/operations.ts · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://github.com/Kamino-Finance/klend-sdk/blob/6a26d6f1b5afb29953ffd139ee8c0c4ca5f26ce6/src/classes/action.ts, https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/how-it-works

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Multiply opens, adjusts and closes a leveraged position in one atomic transaction built on a klend flash loan (0.001% fee on each open, adjust or close). The docs list the open sequence as flash-borrow, swap through Kamino Swap, deposit collateral, borrow the debt asset, repay the flash loan. The SDK builds two variants: flash-borrow the collateral token (deposit and borrow, which carries the elevation-group request, then swap debt to collateral, then repay) or flash-borrow the debt token (swap first, then deposit and borrow). If any step fails, the whole transaction reverts. (high confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/how-it-works · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/concepts, https://github.com/Kamino-Finance/klend-sdk/blob/6a26d6f1b5afb29953ffd139ee8c0c4ca5f26ce6/src/leverage/operations.ts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Kamino-run auto-deleverage is a last-resort tool initiated by its Risk Council under extreme systemic stress: positions get a 72-hour warning, it targets the largest leveraged positions, and Kamino says it has never been triggered. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/risks · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Higher eMode LTVs shrink the gap between operating LTV and the liquidation threshold, so at near-max leverage a modest adverse move in the yield spread (staking yield minus SOL borrow rate) matters more. Kamino names sustained borrow rate above LST yield, and LST smart-contract exploits, as the main liquidation paths for SOL-LST Multiply rather than SOL price moves. (medium confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/how-it-works · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/risks, https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/strategies
- [statement] Kamino publishes a checklist rather than a formula. Before enabling a group, curators should confirm member correlation (test depeg and divergence history), pick the single most liquid or most wanted debt_reserve, cap max_reserves_as_collateral, tighten max_liquidation_bonus_bps to realistic correlated-asset slippage, set per-collateral group borrow limits, and set disable_usage_as_coll_outside_emode to 1 for LSTs (often 0 for stables). Reference ranges are 88-92% LTV and 90-95% threshold for LSTs against their underlying, and 90-95% and 92-97% for stables-only groups. (medium confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/elevation-groups.md · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/curators/markets/risk-parameters.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Kamino prices SOL LSTs by stake rate (SOL staked / LST minted), read from the stake pool account, not by DEX price. A market discount, such as JitoSOL at 0.95 SOL against a 1.05 SOL stake rate, does not change a Multiply position's LTV. A real loss of backing (exploit, slashing) lowers the stake rate and does change it. Kamino says this is why market depegs have not liquidated LST Multiply positions. (medium confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/security/oracles/lst-oracles · keywords: Kamino Multiply and eMode or elevation groups · also: https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/how-it-works, https://kamino.com/docs/products/multiply/risks
